name: Tandoori Lamb Tacos
classification_note: Equals approved pool item #8 (Tandoori Lamb Taco). Lamb costing carries high price risk.
cooking_method: Long marinade, grill lamb to 63 °C (+ rest), 3 tacos

portion.construction: sliced grilled lamb, onion, hari, raita-crema

steps: Grill on high heat to 63 °C (145 °F) minimum, rest 3 min, slice across the grain.

plating: Three tacos, sliced lamb fan, bright herb sauces.
food_safety: Whole-muscle lamb to 63 °C with a 3-minute rest (official guidance; confirm local code); cut/diced or tenderized pieces to 71 °C.
